title: Activation State — provenance that distinguishes a fresh Free install from a lost Pro entitlement
description: Serialized because the distinction must survive a lost or corrupt entitlement cache. Without it, 'no token exists' is ambiguous between NEVER_ACTIVATED and a previously-Pro install whose cache was lost.

subject_id.description: Opaque product subject. Null when NEVER_ACTIVATED.

last_known_tier_id.description: Extensible tier id. Never an enum.

last_observed_server_time.description: Used to detect local clock rollback. A local clock earlier than this degrades to ENTITLEMENT_UNKNOWN.

x-resolution-rules: ACTIVATED_KNOWN + missing/corrupt entitlement + service unavailable -> ENTITLEMENT_UNKNOWN
FREE is the locally available baseline capability set and requires no signed licence from our server.
